newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pasminco setting up new smelter route.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pasminco setting up new smelter route.

text.p: A temporary rail system will be constructed by early next week to allow Pasminco Ltd to resume shipments of lead concentrates to its Port Pirie lead and zinc smelter in South Australia, National Rail Corp said on Thursday.

The smelter in the meantime has sufficient stockpiles of lead and zinc concentrates to maintain current production for up to three weeks, the smelter's general manager, Les Barnett told Reuters. "There will be no disruptions to production," he said.
The railway line between Port Pirie and Pasminco's Broken Hill lead and zinc mine in neighbouring New South Wales has been severed in several places by major flooding.
The mine is located about 500 km from Port Pirie and feeds the smelter about 11,000 tonnes of concentrate a week.
The Port Pirie smelter produces about 200,000 tonnes of lead and 38,000 tonnes of zinc annually.
A temporary rail head is being established in combination with a trucking operation to enable shipments to be maintained, National Rail said.
It will take between four and five weeks to get the main line operating again, barring more heavy rain, it said.
